actions.label: Save Current Frame
actions.tooltip: You must be within the bounding region of a frame for this to work.

actions.label: Reload Current Frame
actions.tooltip: You must be within the bounding region of a frame for this to work. Reverts any changes made since the last save.

actions.label: Remove Current Frame
actions.tooltip: You must be within the bounding region of a frame for this to work.

actions.label: Add New Frame
actions.tooltip: Adds frame to the end of the animation, based on the original selection from the overworld.
